purpose: Independent RaschPy MFRM module: validation protocol, committed before any comparison (only API/timing probes preceded it).

engine.estimation: calibrate(estimation='cp-full-rcl' default): regularised pairwise composite likelihood (persons cancel; ridge penalties, smoothing constants)
engine.se: std_errors(se_method='sandwich') default; 'bootstrap' (200 person resamples, seed 20261118) optional
engine.facets: one rater facet (data (Rater, Person) x items); additional facets unsupported by RaschPy MFRM

not_equivalent: TAM (MML) and RaschPy (RCL) have different objectives and person estimators; their differences are reported, never used as equality evidence
fixtures: examples/mfrm (sha256 in examples/mfrm/fixtures.json); balanced_3facet, unbalanced_linked, interaction_bias; edge cases disconnected, invalid_duplicate_missing, sparse subsets

checks.V1_probability_identity: RaschPy cat_prob_<model> equals the documented log-numerator formula evaluated independently with its fitted parameters: |diff| <= 1e-12 (global, items, thresholds, bivector, matrix)
checks.V2_wle_identity: global model: RaschPy person estimates equal an independent Warm WLE (core.mfrm.wle) given RaschPy item/rater/threshold estimates: |diff| <= 1e-4 (non-extreme persons)
checks.V3_fit_identity: global model: item and rater Infit/Outfit MnSq recomputed independently (Wright & Masters residual definitions at RaschPy person estimates): |diff| <= 1e-6
checks.V4_recovery_global: global model on balanced_3facet and unbalanced_linked: item, rater and threshold estimates within max(3 SE, 0.15) of the generating values (same criterion as the TAM protocol)
checks.V5_null_recovery_extended: items/thresholds/bivector/matrix/centrality/pseudo_halo/bistretch on the same two fixtures (truth has no interaction/stretch): extra effects within max(3 SE, 0.30) of their null (0, or 1 for stretch)
checks.V6_tam_difference: descriptive only: max |RaschPy global - TAM| for centred item/rater/threshold estimates
checks.V7_edge_cases: disconnected design, duplicates, empty middle category, single-level facet, missing scores fail closed or are reported (core.mfrm.prepare reused)

status_rules.CERTIFIED: not attainable: no independent implementation of the same regularised composite-likelihood estimator exists
status_rules.PARTIAL: V1 and the applicable identity checks pass AND recovery (V4 for global, V5 for extended models) passes on both fixtures
status_rules.NOT CERTIFIED: any applicable check fails or no evidence (output withheld or shown with an explicit label)

compute_budget: deterministic fixtures; no Monte Carlo; bootstrap only on explicit user choice
